# Its pace: its drive, one ahead for rapid response hulls alone (4: antimatter's).
sr_fl_1_pace = {
	value = sr_fl_1_drive_value
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_1_all_rapid = yes } add = 1 }
}
sr_fl_1_capacity_base = {
	value = sr_fl_capacity_chemical
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_1_pace >= 1 } value = sr_fl_capacity_fusion }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_1_pace >= 2 } value = sr_fl_capacity_torch }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_1_pace >= 3 } value = sr_fl_capacity_antimatter }
}
# Propellant capacity, km/s: the pace's x (1 + the tenders' share).
sr_fl_1_dv_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_1_tender_share
	add = 1
	multiply = sr_fl_1_capacity_base
}
# Endurance, months: the lowest of its other roles' x (1 + 2 x the tenders'
# share); tenders alone, theirs.
sr_fl_1_endurance = {
	value = sr_fl_endurance_tender
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_1_war_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_war }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_1_rapid_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_rapid }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_1_siege_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_siege }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_1_carrier_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_carrier }
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_1_strength > sr_fl_1_tender_value }
		multiply = { value = sr_fl_1_tender_share multiply = 2 add = 1 }
	}
}
sr_fl_1_marine_capacity = {

	multiply = sr_fl_marines_per_carrier
}

# Repair a month while docked: 20% of the gap at Earth, 10% a Spaceport level
# (the best of ours at the location); 0 elsewhere.

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_1_loc = 1 } value = sr_fl_repair_earth }

		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 3 sr_fl_1_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 3 sr_fl_1_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 3 sr_fl_1_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 3 sr_fl_1_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 3 sr_fl_1_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 4 sr_fl_1_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 4 sr_fl_1_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 4 sr_fl_1_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 4 sr_fl_1_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 4 sr_fl_1_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 5 sr_fl_1_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 5 sr_fl_1_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 5 sr_fl_1_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 5 sr_fl_1_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 5 sr_fl_1_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 6 sr_fl_1_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 6 sr_fl_1_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 6 sr_fl_1_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 6 sr_fl_1_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 6 sr_fl_1_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 7 sr_fl_1_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 7 sr_fl_1_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 7 sr_fl_1_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 7 sr_fl_1_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 7 sr_fl_1_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 8 sr_fl_1_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 8 sr_fl_1_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 8 sr_fl_1_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 8 sr_fl_1_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 8 sr_fl_1_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_neptune_kuiper }
	}
}

# --- Slot 2 ---
sr_fl_2_war_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_war } value = var:sr_fl_2_war }
}
sr_fl_2_war_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_war_full } value = var:sr_fl_2_war_full }
}
sr_fl_2_rapid_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_rapid } value = var:sr_fl_2_rapid }
}
sr_fl_2_rapid_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_rapid_full } value = var:sr_fl_2_rapid_full }
}
sr_fl_2_siege_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_siege } value = var:sr_fl_2_siege }
}
sr_fl_2_siege_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_siege_full } value = var:sr_fl_2_siege_full }
}
sr_fl_2_carrier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_carrier } value = var:sr_fl_2_carrier }
}
sr_fl_2_carrier_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_carrier_full } value = var:sr_fl_2_carrier_full }
}
sr_fl_2_tender_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_tender } value = var:sr_fl_2_tender }
}
sr_fl_2_tender_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_tender_full } value = var:sr_fl_2_tender_full }
}
sr_fl_2_strength = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_2_war_value
	add = sr_fl_2_rapid_value
	add = sr_fl_2_siege_value
	add = sr_fl_2_carrier_value
	add = sr_fl_2_tender_value
}
sr_fl_2_strength_full = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_2_war_full_value
	add = sr_fl_2_rapid_full_value
	add = sr_fl_2_siege_full_value
	add = sr_fl_2_carrier_full_value
	add = sr_fl_2_tender_full_value
}
sr_fl_2_screen_strength = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_2_war_value
	add = sr_fl_2_rapid_value
}
sr_fl_2_tender_share = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_2_strength > 0 }
		value = sr_fl_2_tender_value
		divide = sr_fl_2_strength
	}
}
sr_fl_2_drive_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_drive } value = var:sr_fl_2_drive }
}
sr_fl_2_dv_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_dv } value = var:sr_fl_2_dv }
}
sr_fl_2_supply_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_supply } value = var:sr_fl_2_supply }
}
sr_fl_2_marines_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_marines } value = var:sr_fl_2_marines }
}
sr_fl_2_loc_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc } value = var:sr_fl_2_loc }
}
sr_fl_2_posture_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_posture } value = var:sr_fl_2_posture }
}
# Its pace: its drive, one ahead for rapid response hulls alone (4: antimatter's).
sr_fl_2_pace = {
	value = sr_fl_2_drive_value
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_2_all_rapid = yes } add = 1 }
}
sr_fl_2_capacity_base = {
	value = sr_fl_capacity_chemical
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_2_pace >= 1 } value = sr_fl_capacity_fusion }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_2_pace >= 2 } value = sr_fl_capacity_torch }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_2_pace >= 3 } value = sr_fl_capacity_antimatter }
}
# Propellant capacity, km/s: the pace's x (1 + the tenders' share).
sr_fl_2_dv_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_2_tender_share
	add = 1
	multiply = sr_fl_2_capacity_base
}
# Endurance, months: the lowest of its other roles' x (1 + 2 x the tenders'
# share); tenders alone, theirs.
sr_fl_2_endurance = {
	value = sr_fl_endurance_tender
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_2_war_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_war }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_2_rapid_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_rapid }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_2_siege_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_siege }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_2_carrier_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_carrier }
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_2_strength > sr_fl_2_tender_value }
		multiply = { value = sr_fl_2_tender_share multiply = 2 add = 1 }
	}
}
sr_fl_2_marine_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_2_carrier_value
	multiply = sr_fl_marines_per_carrier
}
sr_fl_2_fire_fleets = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sr_fl_2_war_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_war }
	add = { value = sr_fl_2_rapid_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_rapid }
	add = { value = sr_fl_2_siege_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_siege }
	add = { value = sr_fl_2_carrier_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_carrier }
	add = { value = sr_fl_2_tender_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_tender }
}
sr_fl_2_fire_defences = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sr_fl_2_war_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_war }
	add = { value = sr_fl_2_rapid_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_rapid }
	add = { value = sr_fl_2_siege_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_siege }
	add = { value = sr_fl_2_carrier_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_carrier }
	add = { value = sr_fl_2_tender_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_tender }
}
# Repair a month while docked: 20% of the gap at Earth, 10% a Spaceport level
# (the best of ours at the location); 0 elsewhere.
sr_fl_2_repair_share = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1 } value = sr_fl_repair_earth }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = 2 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_inner multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = 3 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_mars multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = 4 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_asteroids multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = 5 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_jupiter multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = 6 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_saturn multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = 7 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_uranus multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = 8 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_neptune multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = 9 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_kuiper multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
}

	value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_inner_earth
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_2_pace >= 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_inner_earth }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_2_pace >= 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_inner_earth }

		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 2 sr_fl_2_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_inner_earth }

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc }
		if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 2 sr_fl_2_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_inner_earth }

		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 6 sr_fl_2_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 6 sr_fl_2_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_months_torch_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 6 sr_fl_2_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 6 sr_fl_2_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 7 sr_fl_2_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_months_chemical_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 7 sr_fl_2_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 7 sr_fl_2_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_months_torch_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 7 sr_fl_2_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 7 sr_fl_2_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 8 sr_fl_2_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_months_chemical_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 8 sr_fl_2_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 8 sr_fl_2_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_months_torch_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 8 sr_fl_2_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 8 sr_fl_2_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_neptune_kuiper }
	}
}
sr_fl_2_leg_dv_kuiper = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc }
		if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1 sr_fl_2_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1 sr_fl_2_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1 sr_fl_2_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1 sr_fl_2_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1 sr_fl_2_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 2 sr_fl_2_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 2 sr_fl_2_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 2 sr_fl_2_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 2 sr_fl_2_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 2 sr_fl_2_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 3 sr_fl_2_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 3 sr_fl_2_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 3 sr_fl_2_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 3 sr_fl_2_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 3 sr_fl_2_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 4 sr_fl_2_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 4 sr_fl_2_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 4 sr_fl_2_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 4 sr_fl_2_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 4 sr_fl_2_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 5 sr_fl_2_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 5 sr_fl_2_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 5 sr_fl_2_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 5 sr_fl_2_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 5 sr_fl_2_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 6 sr_fl_2_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 6 sr_fl_2_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 6 sr_fl_2_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 6 sr_fl_2_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 6 sr_fl_2_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 7 sr_fl_2_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 7 sr_fl_2_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 7 sr_fl_2_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 7 sr_fl_2_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 7 sr_fl_2_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 8 sr_fl_2_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 8 sr_fl_2_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_neptune_kuiper }

		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_2_loc = 8 sr_fl_2_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_neptune_kuiper }
	}

# --- Slot 3 ---
sr_fl_3_war_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_war } value = var:sr_fl_3_war }
}
sr_fl_3_war_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_war_full } value = var:sr_fl_3_war_full }
}
sr_fl_3_rapid_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_rapid } value = var:sr_fl_3_rapid }
}
sr_fl_3_rapid_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_rapid_full } value = var:sr_fl_3_rapid_full }
}
sr_fl_3_siege_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_siege } value = var:sr_fl_3_siege }
}
sr_fl_3_siege_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_siege_full } value = var:sr_fl_3_siege_full }
}
sr_fl_3_carrier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_carrier } value = var:sr_fl_3_carrier }
}
sr_fl_3_carrier_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_carrier_full } value = var:sr_fl_3_carrier_full }
}
sr_fl_3_tender_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_tender } value = var:sr_fl_3_tender }
}
sr_fl_3_tender_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_tender_full } value = var:sr_fl_3_tender_full }
}
sr_fl_3_strength = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_3_war_value
	add = sr_fl_3_rapid_value
	add = sr_fl_3_siege_value
	add = sr_fl_3_carrier_value
	add = sr_fl_3_tender_value
}
sr_fl_3_strength_full = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_3_war_full_value
	add = sr_fl_3_rapid_full_value
	add = sr_fl_3_siege_full_value
	add = sr_fl_3_carrier_full_value
	add = sr_fl_3_tender_full_value
}
sr_fl_3_screen_strength = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_3_war_value
	add = sr_fl_3_rapid_value
}
sr_fl_3_tender_share = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_3_strength > 0 }
		value = sr_fl_3_tender_value
		divide = sr_fl_3_strength
	}
}
sr_fl_3_drive_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_drive } value = var:sr_fl_3_drive }
}
sr_fl_3_dv_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_dv } value = var:sr_fl_3_dv }
}
sr_fl_3_supply_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_supply } value = var:sr_fl_3_supply }
}
sr_fl_3_marines_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_marines } value = var:sr_fl_3_marines }
}
sr_fl_3_loc_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc } value = var:sr_fl_3_loc }
}
sr_fl_3_posture_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_posture } value = var:sr_fl_3_posture }
}
# Its pace: its drive, one ahead for rapid response hulls alone (4: antimatter's).
sr_fl_3_pace = {
	value = sr_fl_3_drive_value
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_3_all_rapid = yes } add = 1 }
}
sr_fl_3_capacity_base = {
	value = sr_fl_capacity_chemical
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_3_pace >= 1 } value = sr_fl_capacity_fusion }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_3_pace >= 2 } value = sr_fl_capacity_torch }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_3_pace >= 3 } value = sr_fl_capacity_antimatter }
}
# Propellant capacity, km/s: the pace's x (1 + the tenders' share).
sr_fl_3_dv_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_3_tender_share
	add = 1
	multiply = sr_fl_3_capacity_base
}
# Endurance, months: the lowest of its other roles' x (1 + 2 x the tenders'
# share); tenders alone, theirs.
sr_fl_3_endurance = {
	value = sr_fl_endurance_tender
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_3_war_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_war }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_3_rapid_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_rapid }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_3_siege_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_siege }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_3_carrier_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_carrier }
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_3_strength > sr_fl_3_tender_value }
		multiply = { value = sr_fl_3_tender_share multiply = 2 add = 1 }
	}
}
sr_fl_3_marine_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_3_carrier_value
	multiply = sr_fl_marines_per_carrier
}
sr_fl_3_fire_fleets = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sr_fl_3_war_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_war }
	add = { value = sr_fl_3_rapid_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_rapid }
	add = { value = sr_fl_3_siege_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_siege }
	add = { value = sr_fl_3_carrier_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_carrier }
	add = { value = sr_fl_3_tender_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_tender }
}
sr_fl_3_fire_defences = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sr_fl_3_war_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_war }
	add = { value = sr_fl_3_rapid_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_rapid }
	add = { value = sr_fl_3_siege_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_siege }
	add = { value = sr_fl_3_carrier_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_carrier }
	add = { value = sr_fl_3_tender_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_tender }
}
# Repair a month while docked: 20% of the gap at Earth, 10% a Spaceport level
# (the best of ours at the location); 0 elsewhere.
sr_fl_3_repair_share = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 } value = sr_fl_repair_earth }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_inner multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_mars multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_asteroids multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_jupiter multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_saturn multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_uranus multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_neptune multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = 9 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_kuiper multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
}
sr_fl_3_return_dv_inner = {
	value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_inner_earth
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_3_pace >= 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_inner_earth }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_3_pace >= 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_inner_earth }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_3_pace >= 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_inner_earth }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_3_pace >= 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_inner_earth }

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc }
		if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_months_chemical_inner_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_inner_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_months_torch_inner_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_inner_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_inner_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_months_chemical_mars_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_mars_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_months_torch_mars_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_mars_earth }

		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_months_chemical_asteroids_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_asteroids_earth }

		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_asteroids_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_months_chemical_jupiter_earth }

		if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_months_chemical_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_months_torch_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_months_chemical_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_months_torch_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_months_chemical_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_months_torch_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_months_chemical_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_months_torch_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_months_chemical_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_months_torch_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_months_chemical_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_months_torch_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_months_chemical_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_months_torch_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_months_chemical_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_months_torch_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_neptune_kuiper }
	}
}
sr_fl_3_leg_dv_kuiper = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc }
		if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 2 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 3 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 4 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 5 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 6 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 sr_fl_3_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 7 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 sr_fl_3_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 sr_fl_3_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 sr_fl_3_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_neptune_kuiper }

		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_3_loc = 8 sr_fl_3_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_neptune_kuiper }
	}

# --- Slot 4 ---
sr_fl_4_war_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_war } value = var:sr_fl_4_war }
}
sr_fl_4_war_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_war_full } value = var:sr_fl_4_war_full }
}
sr_fl_4_rapid_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_rapid } value = var:sr_fl_4_rapid }
}
sr_fl_4_rapid_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_rapid_full } value = var:sr_fl_4_rapid_full }
}
sr_fl_4_siege_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_siege } value = var:sr_fl_4_siege }
}
sr_fl_4_siege_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_siege_full } value = var:sr_fl_4_siege_full }
}
sr_fl_4_carrier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_carrier } value = var:sr_fl_4_carrier }
}
sr_fl_4_carrier_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_carrier_full } value = var:sr_fl_4_carrier_full }
}
sr_fl_4_tender_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_tender } value = var:sr_fl_4_tender }
}
sr_fl_4_tender_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_tender_full } value = var:sr_fl_4_tender_full }
}
sr_fl_4_strength = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_4_war_value
	add = sr_fl_4_rapid_value
	add = sr_fl_4_siege_value
	add = sr_fl_4_carrier_value
	add = sr_fl_4_tender_value
}
sr_fl_4_strength_full = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_4_war_full_value
	add = sr_fl_4_rapid_full_value
	add = sr_fl_4_siege_full_value
	add = sr_fl_4_carrier_full_value
	add = sr_fl_4_tender_full_value
}
sr_fl_4_screen_strength = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_4_war_value
	add = sr_fl_4_rapid_value
}
sr_fl_4_tender_share = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_4_strength > 0 }
		value = sr_fl_4_tender_value
		divide = sr_fl_4_strength
	}
}
sr_fl_4_drive_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_drive } value = var:sr_fl_4_drive }
}
sr_fl_4_dv_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_dv } value = var:sr_fl_4_dv }
}
sr_fl_4_supply_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_supply } value = var:sr_fl_4_supply }
}
sr_fl_4_marines_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_marines } value = var:sr_fl_4_marines }
}
sr_fl_4_loc_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc } value = var:sr_fl_4_loc }
}
sr_fl_4_posture_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_posture } value = var:sr_fl_4_posture }
}
# Its pace: its drive, one ahead for rapid response hulls alone (4: antimatter's).
sr_fl_4_pace = {
	value = sr_fl_4_drive_value
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_4_all_rapid = yes } add = 1 }
}
sr_fl_4_capacity_base = {
	value = sr_fl_capacity_chemical
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_4_pace >= 1 } value = sr_fl_capacity_fusion }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_4_pace >= 2 } value = sr_fl_capacity_torch }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_4_pace >= 3 } value = sr_fl_capacity_antimatter }
}
# Propellant capacity, km/s: the pace's x (1 + the tenders' share).
sr_fl_4_dv_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_4_tender_share
	add = 1
	multiply = sr_fl_4_capacity_base
}
# Endurance, months: the lowest of its other roles' x (1 + 2 x the tenders'
# share); tenders alone, theirs.
sr_fl_4_endurance = {
	value = sr_fl_endurance_tender
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_4_war_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_war }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_4_rapid_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_rapid }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_4_siege_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_siege }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_4_carrier_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_carrier }
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_4_strength > sr_fl_4_tender_value }
		multiply = { value = sr_fl_4_tender_share multiply = 2 add = 1 }
	}
}
sr_fl_4_marine_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_4_carrier_value
	multiply = sr_fl_marines_per_carrier
}
sr_fl_4_fire_fleets = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sr_fl_4_war_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_war }
	add = { value = sr_fl_4_rapid_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_rapid }
	add = { value = sr_fl_4_siege_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_siege }
	add = { value = sr_fl_4_carrier_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_carrier }
	add = { value = sr_fl_4_tender_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_tender }
}
sr_fl_4_fire_defences = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sr_fl_4_war_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_war }
	add = { value = sr_fl_4_rapid_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_rapid }
	add = { value = sr_fl_4_siege_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_siege }
	add = { value = sr_fl_4_carrier_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_carrier }
	add = { value = sr_fl_4_tender_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_tender }
}
# Repair a month while docked: 20% of the gap at Earth, 10% a Spaceport level
# (the best of ours at the location); 0 elsewhere.
sr_fl_4_repair_share = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = 1 } value = sr_fl_repair_earth }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = 2 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_inner multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = 3 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_mars multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = 4 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_asteroids multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = 5 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_jupiter multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = 6 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_saturn multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = 7 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_uranus multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = 8 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_neptune multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = 9 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_kuiper multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
}
sr_fl_4_return_dv_inner = {
	value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_inner_earth
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_4_pace >= 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_inner_earth }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_4_pace >= 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_inner_earth }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_4_pace >= 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_inner_earth }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_4_pace >= 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_inner_earth }
}

		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 4 sr_fl_4_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_asteroids_neptune }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 4 sr_fl_4_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_asteroids_neptune }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 4 sr_fl_4_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_asteroids_neptune }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 5 sr_fl_4_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_jupiter_neptune }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 5 sr_fl_4_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_jupiter_neptune }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 5 sr_fl_4_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_jupiter_neptune }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 5 sr_fl_4_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_jupiter_neptune }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_4_loc = 5 sr_fl_4_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_jupiter_neptune }

# --- Slot 5 ---
sr_fl_5_war_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_war } value = var:sr_fl_5_war }
}
sr_fl_5_war_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_war_full } value = var:sr_fl_5_war_full }
}
sr_fl_5_rapid_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_rapid } value = var:sr_fl_5_rapid }
}
sr_fl_5_rapid_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_rapid_full } value = var:sr_fl_5_rapid_full }
}
sr_fl_5_siege_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_siege } value = var:sr_fl_5_siege }
}
sr_fl_5_siege_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_siege_full } value = var:sr_fl_5_siege_full }
}
sr_fl_5_carrier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_carrier } value = var:sr_fl_5_carrier }
}
sr_fl_5_carrier_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_carrier_full } value = var:sr_fl_5_carrier_full }
}
sr_fl_5_tender_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_tender } value = var:sr_fl_5_tender }
}
sr_fl_5_tender_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_tender_full } value = var:sr_fl_5_tender_full }
}
sr_fl_5_strength = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_5_war_value
	add = sr_fl_5_rapid_value
	add = sr_fl_5_siege_value
	add = sr_fl_5_carrier_value
	add = sr_fl_5_tender_value
}
sr_fl_5_strength_full = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_5_war_full_value
	add = sr_fl_5_rapid_full_value
	add = sr_fl_5_siege_full_value
	add = sr_fl_5_carrier_full_value
	add = sr_fl_5_tender_full_value
}
sr_fl_5_screen_strength = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_5_war_value
	add = sr_fl_5_rapid_value
}
sr_fl_5_tender_share = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_5_strength > 0 }
		value = sr_fl_5_tender_value
		divide = sr_fl_5_strength
	}
}
sr_fl_5_drive_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_drive } value = var:sr_fl_5_drive }
}
sr_fl_5_dv_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_dv } value = var:sr_fl_5_dv }
}
sr_fl_5_supply_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_supply } value = var:sr_fl_5_supply }
}
sr_fl_5_marines_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_marines } value = var:sr_fl_5_marines }
}
sr_fl_5_loc_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc } value = var:sr_fl_5_loc }
}
sr_fl_5_posture_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_posture } value = var:sr_fl_5_posture }
}
# Its pace: its drive, one ahead for rapid response hulls alone (4: antimatter's).
sr_fl_5_pace = {
	value = sr_fl_5_drive_value
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_5_all_rapid = yes } add = 1 }
}
sr_fl_5_capacity_base = {
	value = sr_fl_capacity_chemical
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_5_pace >= 1 } value = sr_fl_capacity_fusion }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_5_pace >= 2 } value = sr_fl_capacity_torch }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_5_pace >= 3 } value = sr_fl_capacity_antimatter }
}
# Propellant capacity, km/s: the pace's x (1 + the tenders' share).
sr_fl_5_dv_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_5_tender_share
	add = 1
	multiply = sr_fl_5_capacity_base
}
# Endurance, months: the lowest of its other roles' x (1 + 2 x the tenders'
# share); tenders alone, theirs.
sr_fl_5_endurance = {
	value = sr_fl_endurance_tender
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_5_war_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_war }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_5_rapid_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_rapid }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_5_siege_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_siege }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_5_carrier_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_carrier }
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_5_strength > sr_fl_5_tender_value }
		multiply = { value = sr_fl_5_tender_share multiply = 2 add = 1 }
	}
}
sr_fl_5_marine_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_5_carrier_value
	multiply = sr_fl_marines_per_carrier
}
sr_fl_5_fire_fleets = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sr_fl_5_war_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_war }
	add = { value = sr_fl_5_rapid_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_rapid }
	add = { value = sr_fl_5_siege_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_siege }
	add = { value = sr_fl_5_carrier_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_carrier }
	add = { value = sr_fl_5_tender_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_tender }
}
sr_fl_5_fire_defences = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sr_fl_5_war_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_war }
	add = { value = sr_fl_5_rapid_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_rapid }
	add = { value = sr_fl_5_siege_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_siege }
	add = { value = sr_fl_5_carrier_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_carrier }
	add = { value = sr_fl_5_tender_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_tender }
}
# Repair a month while docked: 20% of the gap at Earth, 10% a Spaceport level
# (the best of ours at the location); 0 elsewhere.
sr_fl_5_repair_share = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = 1 } value = sr_fl_repair_earth }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = 2 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_inner multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = 3 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_mars multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = 4 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_asteroids multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = 5 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_jupiter multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = 6 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_saturn multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }

	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_6_war_value
	add = sr_fl_6_rapid_value
	add = sr_fl_6_siege_value
	add = sr_fl_6_carrier_value
	add = sr_fl_6_tender_value
}

	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_6_war_full_value
	add = sr_fl_6_rapid_full_value
	add = sr_fl_6_siege_full_value
	add = sr_fl_6_carrier_full_value
	add = sr_fl_6_tender_full_value
}

	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_6_war_value
	add = sr_fl_6_rapid_value
}

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_6_strength > 0 }
		value = sr_fl_6_tender_value
		divide = sr_fl_6_strength
	}
}

# Its pace: its drive, one ahead for rapid response hulls alone (4: antimatter's).
sr_fl_6_pace = {
	value = sr_fl_6_drive_value
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_6_all_rapid = yes } add = 1 }
}
sr_fl_6_capacity_base = {
	value = sr_fl_capacity_chemical
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_6_pace >= 1 } value = sr_fl_capacity_fusion }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_6_pace >= 2 } value = sr_fl_capacity_torch }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_6_pace >= 3 } value = sr_fl_capacity_antimatter }
}
# Propellant capacity, km/s: the pace's x (1 + the tenders' share).
sr_fl_6_dv_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_6_tender_share
	add = 1
	multiply = sr_fl_6_capacity_base
}
# Endurance, months: the lowest of its other roles' x (1 + 2 x the tenders'
# share); tenders alone, theirs.
sr_fl_6_endurance = {
	value = sr_fl_endurance_tender
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_6_war_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_war }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_6_rapid_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_rapid }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_6_siege_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_siege }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_6_carrier_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_carrier }
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_6_strength > sr_fl_6_tender_value }
		multiply = { value = sr_fl_6_tender_share multiply = 2 add = 1 }
	}
}
sr_fl_6_marine_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_6_carrier_value
	multiply = sr_fl_marines_per_carrier
}
sr_fl_6_fire_fleets = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sr_fl_6_war_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_war }
	add = { value = sr_fl_6_rapid_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_rapid }
	add = { value = sr_fl_6_siege_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_siege }
	add = { value = sr_fl_6_carrier_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_carrier }
	add = { value = sr_fl_6_tender_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_tender }
}
sr_fl_6_fire_defences = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sr_fl_6_war_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_war }
	add = { value = sr_fl_6_rapid_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_rapid }
	add = { value = sr_fl_6_siege_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_siege }
	add = { value = sr_fl_6_carrier_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_carrier }
	add = { value = sr_fl_6_tender_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_tender }
}
# Repair a month while docked: 20% of the gap at Earth, 10% a Spaceport level
# (the best of ours at the location); 0 elsewhere.
sr_fl_6_repair_share = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = 1 } value = sr_fl_repair_earth }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = 2 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_inner multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = 3 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_mars multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = 4 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_asteroids multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = 5 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_jupiter multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = 6 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_saturn multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = 7 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_uranus multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = 8 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_neptune multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = 9 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_kuiper multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
}

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_war_full } value = var:sr_fl_7_war_full }
}
sr_fl_7_rapid_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_rapid } value = var:sr_fl_7_rapid }
}
sr_fl_7_rapid_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_rapid_full } value = var:sr_fl_7_rapid_full }
}
sr_fl_7_siege_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_siege } value = var:sr_fl_7_siege }
}
sr_fl_7_siege_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_siege_full } value = var:sr_fl_7_siege_full }
}
sr_fl_7_carrier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_carrier } value = var:sr_fl_7_carrier }
}
sr_fl_7_carrier_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_carrier_full } value = var:sr_fl_7_carrier_full }
}
sr_fl_7_tender_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_tender } value = var:sr_fl_7_tender }
}
sr_fl_7_tender_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_tender_full } value = var:sr_fl_7_tender_full }
}
sr_fl_7_strength = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_7_war_value
	add = sr_fl_7_rapid_value
	add = sr_fl_7_siege_value
	add = sr_fl_7_carrier_value
	add = sr_fl_7_tender_value
}
sr_fl_7_strength_full = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_7_war_full_value
	add = sr_fl_7_rapid_full_value
	add = sr_fl_7_siege_full_value
	add = sr_fl_7_carrier_full_value
	add = sr_fl_7_tender_full_value
}
sr_fl_7_screen_strength = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_7_war_value
	add = sr_fl_7_rapid_value
}
sr_fl_7_tender_share = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_7_strength > 0 }
		value = sr_fl_7_tender_value
		divide = sr_fl_7_strength
	}
}
sr_fl_7_drive_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_drive } value = var:sr_fl_7_drive }
}
sr_fl_7_dv_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_dv } value = var:sr_fl_7_dv }
}
sr_fl_7_supply_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_supply } value = var:sr_fl_7_supply }
}
sr_fl_7_marines_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_marines } value = var:sr_fl_7_marines }
}
sr_fl_7_loc_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc } value = var:sr_fl_7_loc }
}
sr_fl_7_posture_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_posture } value = var:sr_fl_7_posture }
}
# Its pace: its drive, one ahead for rapid response hulls alone (4: antimatter's).
sr_fl_7_pace = {
	value = sr_fl_7_drive_value
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_7_all_rapid = yes } add = 1 }
}
sr_fl_7_capacity_base = {
	value = sr_fl_capacity_chemical
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_7_pace >= 1 } value = sr_fl_capacity_fusion }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_7_pace >= 2 } value = sr_fl_capacity_torch }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_7_pace >= 3 } value = sr_fl_capacity_antimatter }
}
# Propellant capacity, km/s: the pace's x (1 + the tenders' share).
sr_fl_7_dv_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_7_tender_share
	add = 1
	multiply = sr_fl_7_capacity_base
}
# Endurance, months: the lowest of its other roles' x (1 + 2 x the tenders'
# share); tenders alone, theirs.
sr_fl_7_endurance = {
	value = sr_fl_endurance_tender
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_7_war_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_war }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_7_rapid_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_rapid }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_7_siege_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_siege }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_7_carrier_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_carrier }
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_7_strength > sr_fl_7_tender_value }
		multiply = { value = sr_fl_7_tender_share multiply = 2 add = 1 }
	}
}
sr_fl_7_marine_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_7_carrier_value
	multiply = sr_fl_marines_per_carrier
}
sr_fl_7_fire_fleets = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sr_fl_7_war_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_war }
	add = { value = sr_fl_7_rapid_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_rapid }
	add = { value = sr_fl_7_siege_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_siege }
	add = { value = sr_fl_7_carrier_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_carrier }
	add = { value = sr_fl_7_tender_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_tender }
}
sr_fl_7_fire_defences = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sr_fl_7_war_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_war }
	add = { value = sr_fl_7_rapid_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_rapid }
	add = { value = sr_fl_7_siege_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_siege }
	add = { value = sr_fl_7_carrier_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_carrier }
	add = { value = sr_fl_7_tender_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_tender }
}
# Repair a month while docked: 20% of the gap at Earth, 10% a Spaceport level
# (the best of ours at the location); 0 elsewhere.
sr_fl_7_repair_share = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = 1 } value = sr_fl_repair_earth }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = 2 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_inner multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = 3 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_mars multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = 4 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_asteroids multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = 5 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_jupiter multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = 6 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_saturn multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = 7 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_uranus multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = 8 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_neptune multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = 9 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_kuiper multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
}
sr_fl_7_return_dv_inner = {
	value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_inner_earth
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_7_pace >= 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_inner_earth }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_7_pace >= 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_inner_earth }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_7_pace >= 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_inner_earth }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_7_pace >= 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_inner_earth }
}

	value = 0
	if = {

		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 2 sr_fl_7_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_inner_earth }

	value = 0

		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc }

		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 2 sr_fl_7_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_inner_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 2 sr_fl_7_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_inner_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 2 sr_fl_7_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_inner_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 2 sr_fl_7_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_inner_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 3 sr_fl_7_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_mars_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 3 sr_fl_7_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_mars_earth }

		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 4 sr_fl_7_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 4 sr_fl_7_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 4 sr_fl_7_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 5 sr_fl_7_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 5 sr_fl_7_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 5 sr_fl_7_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 5 sr_fl_7_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 5 sr_fl_7_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_jupiter_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 6 sr_fl_7_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 6 sr_fl_7_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 6 sr_fl_7_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 6 sr_fl_7_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 6 sr_fl_7_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 7 sr_fl_7_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 7 sr_fl_7_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 7 sr_fl_7_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 7 sr_fl_7_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 7 sr_fl_7_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 8 sr_fl_7_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 8 sr_fl_7_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 8 sr_fl_7_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 8 sr_fl_7_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_7_loc = 8 sr_fl_7_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_neptune_kuiper }
	}
}

# --- Slot 8 ---
sr_fl_8_war_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_war } value = var:sr_fl_8_war }
}
sr_fl_8_war_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_war_full } value = var:sr_fl_8_war_full }
}
sr_fl_8_rapid_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_rapid } value = var:sr_fl_8_rapid }
}
sr_fl_8_rapid_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_rapid_full } value = var:sr_fl_8_rapid_full }
}
sr_fl_8_siege_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_siege } value = var:sr_fl_8_siege }
}
sr_fl_8_siege_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_siege_full } value = var:sr_fl_8_siege_full }
}
sr_fl_8_carrier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_carrier } value = var:sr_fl_8_carrier }
}
sr_fl_8_carrier_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_carrier_full } value = var:sr_fl_8_carrier_full }
}
sr_fl_8_tender_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_tender } value = var:sr_fl_8_tender }
}
sr_fl_8_tender_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_tender_full } value = var:sr_fl_8_tender_full }
}
sr_fl_8_strength = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_8_war_value
	add = sr_fl_8_rapid_value
	add = sr_fl_8_siege_value
	add = sr_fl_8_carrier_value
	add = sr_fl_8_tender_value
}
sr_fl_8_strength_full = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_8_war_full_value
	add = sr_fl_8_rapid_full_value
	add = sr_fl_8_siege_full_value
	add = sr_fl_8_carrier_full_value
	add = sr_fl_8_tender_full_value
}
sr_fl_8_screen_strength = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_8_war_value
	add = sr_fl_8_rapid_value
}
sr_fl_8_tender_share = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_8_strength > 0 }
		value = sr_fl_8_tender_value
		divide = sr_fl_8_strength
	}
}
sr_fl_8_drive_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_drive } value = var:sr_fl_8_drive }
}
sr_fl_8_dv_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_dv } value = var:sr_fl_8_dv }
}
sr_fl_8_supply_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_supply } value = var:sr_fl_8_supply }
}
sr_fl_8_marines_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_marines } value = var:sr_fl_8_marines }
}
sr_fl_8_loc_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc } value = var:sr_fl_8_loc }
}
sr_fl_8_posture_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_posture } value = var:sr_fl_8_posture }
}
# Its pace: its drive, one ahead for rapid response hulls alone (4: antimatter's).
sr_fl_8_pace = {
	value = sr_fl_8_drive_value
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_8_all_rapid = yes } add = 1 }
}
sr_fl_8_capacity_base = {
	value = sr_fl_capacity_chemical
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_8_pace >= 1 } value = sr_fl_capacity_fusion }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_8_pace >= 2 } value = sr_fl_capacity_torch }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_8_pace >= 3 } value = sr_fl_capacity_antimatter }
}
# Propellant capacity, km/s: the pace's x (1 + the tenders' share).
sr_fl_8_dv_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_8_tender_share
	add = 1
	multiply = sr_fl_8_capacity_base
}
# Endurance, months: the lowest of its other roles' x (1 + 2 x the tenders'
# share); tenders alone, theirs.
sr_fl_8_endurance = {
	value = sr_fl_endurance_tender
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_8_war_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_war }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_8_rapid_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_rapid }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_8_siege_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_siege }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_8_carrier_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_carrier }
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_8_strength > sr_fl_8_tender_value }
		multiply = { value = sr_fl_8_tender_share multiply = 2 add = 1 }
	}
}
sr_fl_8_marine_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_8_carrier_value
	multiply = sr_fl_marines_per_carrier
}
sr_fl_8_fire_fleets = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sr_fl_8_war_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_war }
	add = { value = sr_fl_8_rapid_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_rapid }
	add = { value = sr_fl_8_siege_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_siege }
	add = { value = sr_fl_8_carrier_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_carrier }
	add = { value = sr_fl_8_tender_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_tender }
}
sr_fl_8_fire_defences = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sr_fl_8_war_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_war }
	add = { value = sr_fl_8_rapid_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_rapid }
	add = { value = sr_fl_8_siege_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_siege }
	add = { value = sr_fl_8_carrier_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_carrier }
	add = { value = sr_fl_8_tender_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_tender }
}
# Repair a month while docked: 20% of the gap at Earth, 10% a Spaceport level
# (the best of ours at the location); 0 elsewhere.
sr_fl_8_repair_share = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = 1 } value = sr_fl_repair_earth }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_inner multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_mars multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = 4 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_asteroids multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = 5 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_jupiter multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = 6 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_saturn multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = 7 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_uranus multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = 8 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_neptune multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = 9 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_kuiper multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
}

		if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 sr_fl_8_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_inner_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 sr_fl_8_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_inner_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 sr_fl_8_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_inner_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 sr_fl_8_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_inner_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 sr_fl_8_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_inner_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 sr_fl_8_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_mars_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 sr_fl_8_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_mars_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 sr_fl_8_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_mars_earth }

		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 7 sr_fl_8_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 7 sr_fl_8_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_months_torch_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 7 sr_fl_8_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 7 sr_fl_8_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 8 sr_fl_8_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_months_chemical_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 8 sr_fl_8_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_months_fusion_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 8 sr_fl_8_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_months_torch_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 8 sr_fl_8_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_neptune_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 8 sr_fl_8_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_neptune_kuiper }
	}
}
sr_fl_8_leg_dv_kuiper = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc }
		if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 1 sr_fl_8_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 1 sr_fl_8_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 1 sr_fl_8_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 1 sr_fl_8_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 1 sr_fl_8_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_earth_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 sr_fl_8_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 sr_fl_8_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 sr_fl_8_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 sr_fl_8_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 2 sr_fl_8_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_inner_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 sr_fl_8_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 sr_fl_8_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 sr_fl_8_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 sr_fl_8_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 3 sr_fl_8_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_mars_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 4 sr_fl_8_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 4 sr_fl_8_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 4 sr_fl_8_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 4 sr_fl_8_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 4 sr_fl_8_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_asteroids_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 5 sr_fl_8_pace = 0 } value = sr_leg_dv_chemical_jupiter_kuiper }

		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 5 sr_fl_8_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_jupiter_kuiper }

		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 6 sr_fl_8_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 6 sr_fl_8_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 6 sr_fl_8_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_saturn_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 6 sr_fl_8_pace = 4 } value = sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_saturn_kuiper }

		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 7 sr_fl_8_pace = 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 7 sr_fl_8_pace = 2 } value = sr_leg_dv_torch_uranus_kuiper }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_fl_8_loc = 7 sr_fl_8_pace = 3 } value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_uranus_kuiper }

# --- Slot 9 ---
sr_fl_9_war_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_war } value = var:sr_fl_9_war }
}
sr_fl_9_war_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_war_full } value = var:sr_fl_9_war_full }
}
sr_fl_9_rapid_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_rapid } value = var:sr_fl_9_rapid }
}
sr_fl_9_rapid_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_rapid_full } value = var:sr_fl_9_rapid_full }
}
sr_fl_9_siege_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_siege } value = var:sr_fl_9_siege }
}
sr_fl_9_siege_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_siege_full } value = var:sr_fl_9_siege_full }
}
sr_fl_9_carrier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_carrier } value = var:sr_fl_9_carrier }
}
sr_fl_9_carrier_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_carrier_full } value = var:sr_fl_9_carrier_full }
}
sr_fl_9_tender_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_tender } value = var:sr_fl_9_tender }
}
sr_fl_9_tender_full_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_tender_full } value = var:sr_fl_9_tender_full }
}
sr_fl_9_strength = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_9_war_value
	add = sr_fl_9_rapid_value
	add = sr_fl_9_siege_value
	add = sr_fl_9_carrier_value
	add = sr_fl_9_tender_value
}
sr_fl_9_strength_full = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_9_war_full_value
	add = sr_fl_9_rapid_full_value
	add = sr_fl_9_siege_full_value
	add = sr_fl_9_carrier_full_value
	add = sr_fl_9_tender_full_value
}
sr_fl_9_screen_strength = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_9_war_value
	add = sr_fl_9_rapid_value
}
sr_fl_9_tender_share = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_9_strength > 0 }
		value = sr_fl_9_tender_value
		divide = sr_fl_9_strength
	}
}
sr_fl_9_drive_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_drive } value = var:sr_fl_9_drive }
}
sr_fl_9_dv_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_dv } value = var:sr_fl_9_dv }
}
sr_fl_9_supply_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_supply } value = var:sr_fl_9_supply }
}
sr_fl_9_marines_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_marines } value = var:sr_fl_9_marines }
}
sr_fl_9_loc_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc } value = var:sr_fl_9_loc }
}
sr_fl_9_posture_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_posture } value = var:sr_fl_9_posture }
}
# Its pace: its drive, one ahead for rapid response hulls alone (4: antimatter's).
sr_fl_9_pace = {
	value = sr_fl_9_drive_value
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_9_all_rapid = yes } add = 1 }
}
sr_fl_9_capacity_base = {
	value = sr_fl_capacity_chemical
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_9_pace >= 1 } value = sr_fl_capacity_fusion }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_9_pace >= 2 } value = sr_fl_capacity_torch }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_9_pace >= 3 } value = sr_fl_capacity_antimatter }
}
# Propellant capacity, km/s: the pace's x (1 + the tenders' share).
sr_fl_9_dv_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_9_tender_share
	add = 1
	multiply = sr_fl_9_capacity_base
}
# Endurance, months: the lowest of its other roles' x (1 + 2 x the tenders'
# share); tenders alone, theirs.
sr_fl_9_endurance = {
	value = sr_fl_endurance_tender
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_9_war_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_war }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_9_rapid_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_rapid }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_9_siege_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_siege }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_9_carrier_value > 0 } max = sr_fl_endurance_carrier }
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_9_strength > sr_fl_9_tender_value }
		multiply = { value = sr_fl_9_tender_share multiply = 2 add = 1 }
	}
}
sr_fl_9_marine_capacity = {
	value = sr_fl_9_carrier_value
	multiply = sr_fl_marines_per_carrier
}
sr_fl_9_fire_fleets = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sr_fl_9_war_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_war }
	add = { value = sr_fl_9_rapid_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_rapid }
	add = { value = sr_fl_9_siege_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_siege }
	add = { value = sr_fl_9_carrier_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_carrier }
	add = { value = sr_fl_9_tender_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_fleets_tender }
}
sr_fl_9_fire_defences = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sr_fl_9_war_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_war }
	add = { value = sr_fl_9_rapid_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_rapid }
	add = { value = sr_fl_9_siege_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_siege }
	add = { value = sr_fl_9_carrier_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_carrier }
	add = { value = sr_fl_9_tender_value multiply = sr_fl_fire_defences_tender }
}
# Repair a month while docked: 20% of the gap at Earth, 10% a Spaceport level
# (the best of ours at the location); 0 elsewhere.
sr_fl_9_repair_share = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = 1 } value = sr_fl_repair_earth }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = 2 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_inner multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = 3 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_mars multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = 4 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_asteroids multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = 5 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_jupiter multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = 6 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_saturn multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = 7 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_uranus multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = 8 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_neptune multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = 9 } value = { value = sr_loc_port_level_kuiper multiply = sr_fl_repair_port_level max = 1 } }
}

	if = { limit = { sr_fl_9_pace >= 1 } value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_inner_earth }
