	add = sr_fl_2_strength
	add = sr_fl_3_strength
	add = sr_fl_4_strength
	add = sr_fl_5_strength
	add = sr_fl_6_strength
	add = sr_fl_7_strength
	add = sr_fl_8_strength
	add = sr_fl_9_strength
}
sr_fl_strength_full_total = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_fl_1_strength_full
	add = sr_fl_2_strength_full
	add = sr_fl_3_strength_full
	add = sr_fl_4_strength_full
	add = sr_fl_5_strength_full
	add = sr_fl_6_strength_full
	add = sr_fl_7_strength_full
	add = sr_fl_8_strength_full
	add = sr_fl_9_strength_full
}
sr_fl_count = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_1_exists = yes } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_2_exists = yes } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_3_exists = yes } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_4_exists = yes } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_5_exists = yes } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_6_exists = yes } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_7_exists = yes } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_8_exists = yes } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { sr_fl_9_exists = yes } add = 1 }
}

# ===== The build mix (design § 5), country scope: each role's weight (its start
# weight while unset) and its share of the month's construction; with every
# weight at 0, warships take it all. =====
sr_sc_mix_total = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_sc_mix_war_value
	add = sr_sc_mix_rapid_value
	add = sr_sc_mix_siege_value
	add = sr_sc_mix_carrier_value
	add = sr_sc_mix_tender_value
}
sr_sc_mix_war_value = {
	value = sr_sc_mix_start_war
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_sc_mix_war } value = var:sr_sc_mix_war }
}
sr_sc_mix_share_war = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_sc_mix_total > 0 } value = sr_sc_mix_war_value divide = sr_sc_mix_total }
	else = { value = 1 }
}
sr_sc_mix_rapid_value = {
	value = sr_sc_mix_start_rapid
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_sc_mix_rapid } value = var:sr_sc_mix_rapid }
}
sr_sc_mix_share_rapid = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_sc_mix_total > 0 } value = sr_sc_mix_rapid_value divide = sr_sc_mix_total }
}
sr_sc_mix_siege_value = {
	value = sr_sc_mix_start_siege
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_sc_mix_siege } value = var:sr_sc_mix_siege }
}
sr_sc_mix_share_siege = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_sc_mix_total > 0 } value = sr_sc_mix_siege_value divide = sr_sc_mix_total }
}
sr_sc_mix_carrier_value = {
	value = sr_sc_mix_start_carrier
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_sc_mix_carrier } value = var:sr_sc_mix_carrier }
}
sr_sc_mix_share_carrier = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_sc_mix_total > 0 } value = sr_sc_mix_carrier_value divide = sr_sc_mix_total }
}
sr_sc_mix_tender_value = {
	value = sr_sc_mix_start_tender
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_sc_mix_tender } value = var:sr_sc_mix_tender }
}
sr_sc_mix_share_tender = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_sc_mix_total > 0 } value = sr_sc_mix_tender_value divide = sr_sc_mix_total }
}

# ===== The ground reserve (6d, design § 15), country scope: each role's strength
# built and not yet launched (sr_reserve_<role>), all at full, and their sum. =====
sr_reserve_war_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_reserve_war } value = var:sr_reserve_war }
}
sr_reserve_rapid_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_reserve_rapid } value = var:sr_reserve_rapid }
}
sr_reserve_siege_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_reserve_siege } value = var:sr_reserve_siege }
}
sr_reserve_carrier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_reserve_carrier } value = var:sr_reserve_carrier }
}
sr_reserve_tender_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_reserve_tender } value = var:sr_reserve_tender }
}
sr_reserve_total = {
	value = 0
	add = sr_reserve_war_value
	add = sr_reserve_rapid_value
	add = sr_reserve_siege_value
	add = sr_reserve_carrier_value
	add = sr_reserve_tender_value
}

# ===== Combat (6b), per world =====
#   sr_cb_closing_<key>   strength closing in on it, every power's (any scope)
#   sr_cb_fd_total_<key>  the defence fire aimed at it: each power's, shared with
#                         the hostile fleets stationed against it by strength
#   sr_cb_edge_<key>      a power's: Survey Colony Defences' edge against its holder
sr_cb_closing_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = sr_fleet_powers }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_valles_marineris }
			add = var:sr_cb_s3_valles_marineris
		}
	}
}
sr_cb_fd_total_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = sr_fleet_powers }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_fd3_valles_marineris }
			add = { value = var:sr_cb_fd3_valles_marineris multiply = sr_site_target_strength_valles_marineris divide = { value = sr_site_target_strength_valles_marineris add = sr_cb_hs_value } }
		}
	}
}
sr_cb_edge_valles_marineris = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { sr_cov_surveys_valles_marineris = yes has_variable = sr_cov_survey_mult }
		add = { value = var:sr_cov_survey_mult multiply = sr_cov_survey_edge }
	}
}

# ===== Per location, country scope: the AI's offence (6c, design § 14) =====
#   sr_loc_ai_enemy_fleets_<loc>  the strength of every fleet there of a country
#                                 at war with us (at Earth too: 6d's blockade,
#                                 the reserve's launch and orbital superiority)
#   sr_loc_ai_enemy_force_<loc>   ... and the Defences and hull of each world there
#                                 we may attack (sr_site_target_strength_<key>)
sr_loc_ai_enemy_fleets_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = sr_fleet_powers }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_war_with = prev has_variable = sr_fl_at_earth }
			add = var:sr_fl_at_earth
		}
	}
}
sr_loc_ai_enemy_fleets_inner = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = sr_fleet_powers }

			limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_war_with = prev has_variable = sr_fl_at_inner }
			add = var:sr_fl_at_inner
		}
	}
}

# ===== Per world, any scope: its worth to the AI's offence (6c, design § 14):
# a point a 10,000 people and one a module level =====
sr_site_ai_worth_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris divide = 10000 add = sr_site_spec_built_valles_marineris add = sr_site_generic_built_valles_marineris }
sr_site_ai_worth_olympus_mons = { value = sr_site_pop_value_olympus_mons divide = 10000 add = sr_site_spec_built_olympus_mons add = sr_site_generic_built_olympus_mons }
sr_site_ai_worth_hellas_planitia = { value = sr_site_pop_value_hellas_planitia divide = 10000 add = sr_site_spec_built_hellas_planitia add = sr_site_generic_built_hellas_planitia }

sr_site_ai_worth_vesta = { value = sr_site_pop_value_vesta divide = 10000 add = sr_site_spec_built_vesta add = sr_site_generic_built_vesta }
sr_site_ai_worth_psyche = { value = sr_site_pop_value_psyche divide = 10000 add = sr_site_spec_built_psyche add = sr_site_generic_built_psyche }
sr_site_ai_worth_pallas = { value = sr_site_pop_value_pallas divide = 10000 add = sr_site_spec_built_pallas add = sr_site_generic_built_pallas }
sr_site_ai_worth_hygiea = { value = sr_site_pop_value_hygiea divide = 10000 add = sr_site_spec_built_hygiea add = sr_site_generic_built_hygiea }

# ===== Per location, country scope: the best Spaceport level of ours there =====
# (an occupied world's serves no one).
sr_loc_port_level_inner = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_venus } } min = sr_site_port_value_venus }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_mercury } } min = sr_site_port_value_mercury }
}
